key_facts.fact: Researchers at MIT CSAIL and Tianjin University developed X-Hinges, a software and fabrication method for 3D printing self-sensing compliant mechanisms.
X-Hinges uses multi-material FDM 3D printing to automatically embed resistive sensing elements directly during fabrication without requiring post-assembly.
The software enables the creation of everyday interactive items like lamps and gloves that perceive and adaptively respond to human contact.
